title.en: Chapter 5 — Who Wanted Him Out of the Shop
title.ar: الفصل 5 — مين بده يطلعه من الدكان

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: سألت بالبناية مين هو دنكان روس؟
sentences.en: Holmes said: did you ask in the building who Duncan Ross was?
Wilson said: I asked.
They said there was no one by that name.
And the office had been rented to a lawyer, who had left.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: وسبولدينغ، شو قال لما حكيت له؟
sentences.en: Holmes said: and Spaulding, what did he say when you told him?

sentences.ar: قال ويلسون: قال: يمكن يبعتوا لك مكتوب.
sentences.en: Wilson said: he said: perhaps they will send you a letter.
Wait.
Holmes said: describe Spaulding to me.
Wilson said: small, short, quick.

sentences.ar: عمره تلاتين، بس وجهه بلا لحية.
sentences.en: Thirty years old, but a hairless face.

sentences.ar: وعلى جبينه علامة بيضا، من حمض.
sentences.en: And a white mark on his forehead, from acid.
Holmes sat up straight in his chair.
He said: and his ears pierced for earrings?
Wilson said: yes!

sentences.ar: قال إنه غجري عمل هيك فيه وهو زغير.
sentences.en: He said a gypsy did it when he was small.
Holmes said: and he is still with you?
Wilson said: I left him in the shop just now.
Holmes said: good.
Go home.

sentences.ar: اليوم سبت، وبيوم الاتنين بيكون عندي جواب.
sentences.en: Today is Saturday, and by Monday I will have an answer.

sentences.ar: لما راح ويلسون، هولمز لف رجليه تحته، وسكر عينه، وحط غليونه بتمه.
sentences.en: When Wilson had gone, Holmes folded his legs under him, closed his eyes, and put his pipe in his mouth.
He said: Watson, what do you think?
I said: I understand nothing.
The whole story is mad.

sentences.ar: قال: كل ما كانت الشغلة أغرب، كانت أسهل.
sentences.en: He said: the stranger a thing is, the easier it is.

sentences.ar: الجرايم العادية هي الصعبة، لأنه ما فيها شي بيميزها.
sentences.en: It is the ordinary crimes that are hard, because there is nothing in them to distinguish them.
And this is a three-pipe problem.
Do not speak to me for fifty minutes.

sentences.ar: وبعد خمسين دقيقة، نط، وقال: في موسيقى اليوم بعد الظهر.
sentences.en: And after fifty minutes, he sprang up, and said: there is a concert this afternoon.
Come.

sentences.ar: بس بالطريق، وقف عند دكان ويلسون، بالحارة الفقيرة.
sentences.en: But on the way, he stopped at Wilson's shop, in the poor neighbourhood.

sentences.ar: دكان قديم، وعليه تلات كرات ذهب، علامة الرهن.
sentences.en: An old shop, with three golden balls over it, the sign of the pawnbroker.
And Holmes stood before it, and looked at the houses.

sentences.ar: وبعدين ضرب الرصيف بعصايته، تلات مرات.
sentences.en: And then struck the pavement with his stick, three times.
And knocked on the door.

sentences.ar: فتح شاب نضيف، بلا لحية، وسريع.
sentences.en: A clean-shaven youth opened, quick.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: لو سمحت، كيف بروح على ستراند؟
sentences.en: Holmes said: excuse me, how do I get to the Strand?

sentences.ar: قال الشاب: تالت يمين، رابع شمال.
sentences.en: The youth said: third right, fourth left.
And shut the door.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: رابع أذكى رجل بلندن.
sentences.en: Holmes said: the fourth cleverest man in London.
And perhaps the third.

sentences.ar: قلت: يعني إنت سألته عن الطريق عشان تشوف وجهه؟
sentences.en: I said: you mean you asked him the way just to see his face?
He said: no.
To see the knees of his trousers.

sentences.ar: وبعدين لفينا حول البناية، للشارع الكبير اللي وراها.
sentences.en: And then we went round the block, to the big street behind it.
A clean street, big shops, and a bank.

sentences.ar: هولمز وقف قدام البنك، وقرا اسمه: بنك المدينة والضواحي، فرع كوبرغ.
sentences.en: Holmes stood in front of the bank, and read its name: City and Suburban Bank, Coburg branch.
And he said: Watson, the concert.
And then work tonight.
I said: what work?

sentences.ar: قال: جريمة كبيرة رح تصير الليلة، بشارع ويلسون.
sentences.en: He said: a big crime is going to happen tonight, in Wilson's street.
And we must stop it.
And at the concert, Holmes sat with his eyes closed.

sentences.ar: وإصبعه بيتحرك مع اللحن، ووجهه سعيد.
sentences.en: His finger moving with the music, his face happy.

sentences.ar: وأنا قاعد جنبه، وبفكر: كيف بيقدر واحد يكون هيك هادي، وهو بيطارد قاتل؟
sentences.en: And I sat beside him, thinking: how can a man be so calm, while hunting a criminal?
